source_claims.claim: IRT measurement avoids spurious genotype-environment interaction and is described as unbiased
source_claims.evidence_limit: One source-length dataset and unconverged diagnostic grids do not reproduce repeated-simulation bias or power.

source_claims.claim: Full-information treatment of incomplete covariates is described as more powerful than deletion
source_claims.operational_evidence: The source simulation compares estimated variance-component standard errors. Lower estimated SE is a precision proxy; direct rejection-rate power and its source uncertainty are not reported here.
source_claims.replication_limit: Retain full SE comparisons, but do not promote their ordering into a directly reproduced power probability.

reporting_requirement: Abstract cites the dissertation and identifies original claims; first-page magnitude labels are descriptive with explicit estimand, direction, tolerance and inference limits. No same/equivalence classification for unresolved comparisons.
